findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Book one visit for the customer, as a request the business approves (or, for a business that takes its bookings by email, confirms with the customer itself); th…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: book · Private data: book · Public sink: check_address, book.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: book · Private data: book · Public sink: check_address, book

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
